notes.subject: ओकनी
notes.rationale: Magahi needs the plural pronoun to name the erring plotters; Hebrew leaves the subject in the verb

notes.subject: וחסד ואמת
notes.rationale: 'kindness and truth will be to those devising good' — some read the pair as what the plotters-of-good receive, others as what they themselves show

notes.subject: חרשי ... חרשי
notes.rationale: the same participle 'plotters/ploughers' frames both halves of the antithesis; the echo is kept

translation: की बुराय रचए वाला ⟨ओकनी⟩ भटकिए नञ जातइ? बाकि हेसेद आउ सच ओकनी के मिलतइ जे भलाय रचऽ हथिन।
